text:
How ParkGuide answers

What happens to a question, what leaves this computer, and what stays on it.

Each turn's inspector (Data flow tab) records what actually happened for that question. Use it rather than this general description.

1

Your question and selected park first reach local checks

This computer

The browser sends them only to this loopback server. Pattern checks refuse recognized phrasings of other-park, live-condition and private-record requests before anything leaves the machine. They only recognize certain wordings: a differently worded request can continue to search and the steps below, where it may still be refused.

2

The retrieval query is embedded when needed

One Azure endpoint

If the query vector is not already in the local cache, the retrieval query text is sent to the Azure embedding deployment. The vector is then saved in the local cache under the query's SHA-256 hash.

3

Saved NPS passages are searched and reranked locally

This computer

SQLite, NumPy cosine similarity and BM25 search only the selected park's saved passages; a local cross-encoder reranks the candidates.

4

An answer is drafted from selected snippets

Same Azure resource (Luna)

The question, the selected snippets and a bounded slice of this conversation are sent to Luna, which must cite passage IDs for every factual claim.

5

Each claim gets an AI source review

Same Azure resource (Luna)

A separate review call receives the question, conversation, drafted claims and only the passages those claims cite. Unsupported claims are withheld; deterministic number, citation and quotation checks also run locally.

6

Only reviewed claims and saved source links return

This computer

The browser receives the reviewed answer, saved excerpts and official NPS links. Nothing is displayed until review finishes.

Snapshot, not live conditions. Saved pages reflect their capture date. Closures, weather and availability can differ today.

AI review is not human verification. “Source review passed” means a model found verbatim supporting witnesses in the cited passages. It does not establish accuracy or guarantee the absence of errors.

What stays where. Conversation text is kept in this tab's memory and is lost on reload; it is sent to the local server with each question, which does not store it. Some derived data does persist on this computer: the local embedding cache keeps the SHA-256 hash and vector of each embedded retrieval query (not its text), and the budget ledger records each paid call's kind, time, status, tokens and estimated cost (no text).

Remote retention. Text sent to Azure is handled under Azure's own terms. ParkGuide requests store=false for answer and review calls; that request does not by itself guarantee that the provider keeps no data.

The one Azure resource. https://rd-foundry-dev-eastus2.cognitiveservices.azure.com serves both deployments: text-embedding-3-small for embeddings and gpt-6-luna (model gpt-6-luna-2026-09-22) for drafting and review. No other model provider is called.

Local models. Embedding dimension 1536. Reranker cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 runs on this computer from its local cache.
